description:
MarketPulse: The AI-visibility layer for businesses anywhere in the world — get found by the assistants doing the choosing. Live AI-visibility check with verbatim site evidence ($0.50: per-crawler robots.txt rules, llms.txt, Schema.org, NAP), LLM visibility strategy, country-aware local SEO, channel mix, content briefs, ad copy, competitor gap, ROI forecasting. 12 endpoints, global platforms incl. WeChat/Douyin/LINE/Naver.

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • llm-visibility ($0.15): LLM visibility analysis
  • content-brief ($0.15): Dual-optimized content brief
  • channel-mix ($0.10): Marketing channel mix strategy
  • roi-forecast ($0.08): Marketing ROI forecast
  • competitor-gap ($0.10): Competitor gap analysis
  • ad-copy ($0.08): Ready-to-use ad copy variants
  • email-sequence ($0.15): Email nurture sequence
  • social-strategy ($0.08): Platform social media strategy
  • local-seo ($0.08): Local SEO optimization guide
  • seo-audit ($0.10): Technical SEO review
  • seo-review ($0.10): Technical SEO review
  • ai-visibility-check ($0.50): Live AI-visibility check (GEO/AEO) w/ verbatim site evidence
  • video-ad-script ($0.10): Shot-by-shot video ad script
  • voiceover-script ($0.08): TTS-ready voiceover script
  • ai-visibility-probe ($0.25): AI-visibility probe (GEO/AEO) — $0.25 agent-tier preview

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: llm-visibility | content-brief | channel-mix | roi-forecast | competitor-gap | ad-copy | email-sequence | social-strategy | local-seo | seo-audit | seo-review | ai-visibility-check | video-ad-script | voiceover-script | ai-visibility-probe

audience.description: Who this content is written for — sharpens tone and structure

brand.description: The brand to assess AI-answer visibility for — provide brand and/or topic

budget.description: Monthly marketing budget, with currency and period

business.description: The type of business to build a local SEO plan for

business_type.description: The business or offer to plan a channel mix for

channels.description: Comma-separated channels to forecast — defaults to a general digital-marketing mix

competitor.description: The competitor brand or company to analyze

domain.description: the website to check — bare domain, any country

duration.description: Target video length in seconds — defaults to 30

format.description: Voiceover format: video_ad, explainer, podcast_ad, youtube_intro or ivr_greeting — defaults to video_ad

goals.description: Primary marketing goal to optimize the mix around

industry.description: The industry to benchmark ROI projections against

lang.description: Language to respond in — defaults to English

location.description: City and state/region the business serves — sharpens citation and competitor guidance

platform.description: Ad platform to write copy for

product.description: The product or service being advertised

sequence_type.description: Type of sequence to write — welcome, nurture, abandoned_cart, post_purchase, or re_engagement

stage.description: Business stage — startup, growth, or scale

tone.description: Voice tone direction in plain language

topic.description: The topic or category to assess AI visibility within — provide brand and/or topic

name: marketpulse
